# Extract the 'Structural type' column to identify towers
tower_rows = df[df['Structural type'].str.contains('Tower', case=False, na=False)]

# Sort by the 'Height\nmetres / ft' column to find the tallest tower
# The 'Height\nmetres / ft' column contains strings like "146 / 480", we need to extract the numeric height in metres
tower_rows['Height_metres'] = tower_rows['Height\nmetres / ft'].str.extract(r'(\d+\.?\d*)').astype(float)

# Find the row with the maximum height among towers
tallest_tower = tower_rows.loc[tower_rows['Height_metres'].idxmax()]

# Get the country of that tower
answer = tallest_tower['Country']
